title: CAIRN #3 (3 STACK)
alt: Three stacked takeout containers, ceramic covered in pale green glaze.

title: Takhi/Przewalski's horse art (various)
alt: Clay sculpture of a Przewalski's horse. Left half is a brick with a painting of the horse's back half mimicking the Laxcaux style cave paintings. Right half is a sculpture of the horse's head and front legs.

title: painted snail shells
alt: Three big snail shells, painted in intricate, colorful, geometric patterns.

title: amethyst scarab
alt: Round, purple amethyst, with lines etched to make it look like a curled scarab.

title: opalized dinosaur femur
alt: Big, fragmented bone, entirely made out of bright blue, iridescent opal.

title: embroidered leaves (various)
alt: Two dry, brown leaves, encircled and held together with beige thread lace.

title: Bohemian cranberry glass thimble
alt: Red glass thimble with white flowers etched into it.

title: circuit board insects (various)
alt: A fly made out of green circuit board, with wires for legs and orange-green plastic wings.

title: jewelry comb 'Mistletoe'
alt: Hair comb made out of pearl, horn, gold and bronze. It has four downwards teeth and the top is decorated with swirls, pearls and metal green leaves.

title: Przewalski's horse
alt: Small, crude sculpture of a cute, brown horse, with markings to make it look like a Przewalski's horse.

title: unguentarium, dove-shaped perfume bottle
alt: Greenish blown glass perfume bottle in the form of a bird, with a 'spout' beak and an open-ended tubular tail. The body has long tooled indents to represent plumage.

title: fish spoon
alt: Wooden spoon carved to look like a fish, with the head as the bowl and the body and tail as the handle.

title: Art Nouveau Fairy Lamp
alt: Intricate silver metal and natural shell lamp. The base depicts an elf or fairy emerging from the water with arms outstretched as she looks at a lotus blossom in front of her. The shade hangs on a short metal stem above the fairy, and is made out of natural shell.

title: citrine mouse
alt: Curled up mouse, carved out of semi-translucent, yellow citrine.
artist: Carl Fabergé worksmen, probably Michael Perchin or Henrik Wigström

title: gemstone carvings (various)
alt: Four slices of a citrus fruit, carved out of orange agate.

title: turqoise hippopotamus 'William'
alt: A hippopotamus carved out of blue turquoise. It has black markings in the shape of reeds on its skin.

title: amethyst frog ring
alt: Golden ring with a frog carved out of purple amethyst inset as the jewel.

title: 'I remember You''
alt: Clay sculpture of a black cat standing on top of a bust of a person, which is grey and laying flat on its back.

title: 'folklore' sculptures
alt: A set of ceramic sculptures glazed in two shades of purple. It depicts a sheep, leaning down as if to eat grass, and a wobbly, distorted version of the sculpture beneath the sheep's feet, imitating a water reflection.

title: dog in the wind
alt: Simple, beige clay sculpture depicting a dog stanging with its tail straight behind it and its face straight forward, as if struggling against intense wind.

title: floral ceramic triceratops
alt: Three ceramic sculptures of cute, simplified dinosaur of the type Triceratops. The ones on the sides are white with blue floral markings on the skin, and the one in the middle is dark blue with white floral markings. Their horns are gold.

title: Mayan golden frog
alt: Crude golden sculptuire of a frog, with turquoise gemstones for the eyes.

title: dragonfly dagger
alt: Metal dagger with a dark blue, shiny hilt. The guard is in the shape of butterfly wings.

title: ceramic horse
alt: White, fat ceramic horse, covered in black markings depicting the saddle and tack, as well as its mane and tail hair.

title: felt fish sculpture (various)
alt: Several hanging sculptures of colorful fish, laying on a wooden floor. The fish are realistic felt patchwork, hanging from a glass buoy covered in thin rope net.
